THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
030
STUDY 057
Blue Lace Blouse & Honey Waves
Rights check
Source: 24402.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, honey-blonde hair
falling over one shoulder sits against a deep blue
backdrop. She wears a sheer blue blouse with
lace-trimmed cuffs and a ruffled placket, and a single
silver drop earring. Her expression is calm and direct,
with light freckles. Even studio light, a palette of
cornflower blue, honey gold, and soft peach skin. Soft
and retro, in the style of a late-1990s editorial portrait.
Soft, retro, editorial
WORKING NOTES
- The sheer lace blouse and honey hair are the key
textures.
- Add 'film grain' to match the vintage print look.
